where: #katmanlar 'Alt sayfa.' + #etkilesim row 'sheet' ('giriş yay orta (384 ms oturur, panel yedeği linear())') vs #platform iOS 'Alt sayfa' ('Açılış ve kapanış hareketi sistemindir; süresi ve eğrisi token değildir') vs #hareket Süreler 'genis 300 ms' ('Alt sayfa ve yan panel girişi') vs #acik 01
problem: The phone bottom sheet has four incompatible motion specs: withSpring orta 384 ms + exit 200 ms (Katmanlar, Etkileşim, Özet 'alt sayfa orta ile açılır'); genis 300 ms (Süreler); system motion that is not a token (Platform, TrueSheet = UISheetPresentationController / Material BottomSheet, which a Reanimated spring cannot drive at all); and 'alt sayfa sistemin kendi hareketiyle mi açılır' listed as undecided (Açık nokta 01). The spring version also breaks the document's own rule 'çıkış girişten kısadır (oran 0.67 ile 0.75)': 200/384 = 0.52. Yaylar says the web fallback keeps 'aynı süre' (384 ms) but the demo CSS falls back to --dur-genis 300 ms. The first real question a developer hits.
fix: Pick one. With TrueSheet: #etkilesim sheet row 'Süre: sistem (TrueSheet); Azaltılmış: sistem'; remove 'Alt sayfa' from the uses of genis, orta (200) and spring orta; Özet 'alt sayfa sistemin hareketiyle açılır'; label the web sheet as illustration; keep Açık nokta 01 for the panel drawer only. If a custom sheet is wanted, drop TrueSheet and give the exit a duration that meets the 0.67 to 0.75 rule.

where: Hero meta 'Bu sayfadaki her renk, ölçü ve süre tokens.json dosyasından gelir'; #etkilesim 'Değerler tokens.json içindeki patterns dizisinden gelir.'; #hareket Yaylar 'spring.js ile üretilen linear()'; #kutuphaneler-ortak 'tek bir DTCG 2025.10 token dosyasında durur'
problem: The cited source of truth is not delivered: the repo gets only tasarim.html; tokens.json, spring.js, tcheck.js, color.js, coverage.js, shot.js live in a scratch folder. The tokens.json the page was built from is a custom schema (name, undertone, color.neutral[{step,L,C,H,hex}], patterns), not the DTCG file Kütüphaneler mandates, so 'tokens.json' names two different files. The text never shows DTCG token paths or one $type/$value example (OKLCH object + hex fallback, {value, unit}, cubicBezier, 3-number spring group), never lists att.* tokens (att.gorevli.fg etc. appear only as names in the Kontrast table), and never lists the reduced-motion and high-contrast token files. The tokens module and the Style Dictionary config cannot be written without scraping the page CSS.
fix: Commit tokens/ beside tasarim.html (DTCG .tokens.json, reduced-motion and contrast override files, spring.js, color.js, tcheck.js) or add a 'Token dosyası' section printing the full DTCG JSON; name that path in the hero line; add an att.* and status.* table with OKLCH and hex.

where: #etkilesim row 'success' 'stroke-dashoffset (kare ve onay çizimi), transform: scale (yay imza)' vs #kutuphaneler-telefon 'Köşeli onay işareti düz View çubuklarıyla çizilir'
problem: The signature moment cannot be built from the text. Technique contradicts (SVG stroke drawing vs View bars animated by transform and opacity only; the stroke animation also breaks #hareket Kurallar 01 'Yalnız transform ve opacity canlandırılır'). Values exist only in demo CSS: mark 72, square stroke 2, check stroke 4 square caps, spring imza scale starting at 0.92, title and step curve ease-giris while the table says 'Eğri imza'. 'başlık 200 ms'de 8 px aşağıdan gelir' is ambiguous (demo: 200 ms delay, 150 ms duration).
fix: One spec block: react-native-svg Path with animated strokeDashoffset (named as the only exception to Kurallar 01), 72 dp, strokes 2 and 4 dp; square 0 to 240 ms ease-imza; check 160 to 400 ms ease-imza; scale 0.92 to 1 withSpring imza; title+meta delay 200 ms, 150 ms ease-giris, translateY 8 to 0; steps delay 260/320/380 ms, 150 ms ease-giris; reduced 110 ms opacity. Delete the View-bars sentence.

where: #bilesenler 'Düğmeler' note 'panel 40 · telefon 48 · küçük 32'; #durumlar 'Damga: 1 px durum renginde çerçeve ..., 16 px ikon, 13 px yazı'
problem: Component anatomy is missing; button, input, dialog, toast and stamp cannot be built without reading demo CSS: button padding (16; phone 20; small 12), min-width 64, icon 20/24 and gap 8, per-variant disabled colors, loading-label rule (state table turns 'Vazgeç' and 'Kaydı sil' into 'Gönderiliyor'); input 40 high, padding 12; dialog width 480 and a footer of two 64 px full-bleed buttons (contradicts 40/48/32); panel toast 400 wide at right/bottom 24; phone toast position and its close button 40x40, below the 48 dp minimum; stamp padding 3/8/3/6, gap 6; phone checkbox size. Demo values are often off the stated scale ('Bütün ölçüler 4'ün katı'): 3, 6, 10, 14, 18, 20, 28 px.
fix: Add an anatomy table per component (height, padding x/y, gap, icon size, type token, border, per-state colors, width/position) using scale values only, plus the loading-label rule ('Siliniyor'; no loading state on a ghost cancel); align demo CSS to it; phone toast close 48x48.

where: #renk 'Tehlike' roles '#971A1D', '#861116'; #durumlar Görevli '#652F94'; #ozet 'İncelemede mor #7839A5. Görevli mor'
problem: Rubric D1 asks OKLCH and hex for every color token; danger.fillHover, danger.fillPressed and att.gorevli have hex only, and #652F94 is missing from the 39 Anlam rolleri. The Özet line reads as if Görevli uses the warning purple #7839A5; Durumlar uses another purple.
fix: Add oklch(0.4393 0.1598 26.0) for #971A1D, oklch(0.3992 0.1500 25.9) for #861116, oklch(0.4300 0.1599 305.1) for #652F94 (color.js); add att.gorevli.fg/border to the roles; Özet: 'Görevli koyu mor #652F94'.

where: #hareket Kurallar 10 'renk ve opaklık 100 ile 150 ms kalır'; #erisilebilirlik 'Animasyonları kaldır: değişim anında; opaklık geçişi de yoktur'; #kutuphaneler 'kısalır ya da sıfırlanır'
problem: Reduced-motion values are never listed per token. Dialog, toast, banner say only 'Yalnız opaklık' and the demo plays them at 200 ms, outside 100 to 150. Android removes fades, iOS keeps them, but the hook is one boolean and the table keeps fades. Stack: 'fade' (#platform), 'fade ya da none' (#kutuphaneler), prefersCrossFadeTransitions() (#erisilebilirlik). Toast: 'kendiliğinden kalkar' (#kutuphaneler) vs 'Yalnız opaklık' (#etkilesim). Loader keeps an 'opaklık nabzı' that Kurallar 09 bans ('nabız ... kullanılmaz'). No mechanism makes springs follow a live change (ReduceMotion.System reads Reanimated's own flag; ReduceMotion.Never is banned).
fix: Add a reduced token table (each dur to its reduced value), one Android rule (reduce on Android: 0 ms), one stack rule ('fade' when the hook is true), an explicit loader exception or a static mark, and the way the live hook value reaches Reanimated.

where: #katmanlar 'Yükleniyor' '1 sn altı gösterge yok' vs #bilesenler 'Birincil düğmeye basınca 1,8 sn yükleniyor durumu gösterilir'
problem: The button demo shows the trace from 0 ms; the e-posta kodu demo shows 'Kod denetleniyor' with the trace for a 900 ms check; the scan demo shows 'Okundu, kaydediliyor' at once. When the trace starts is unclear.
fix: Rule: at press aria-busy='true' and disabled at once; trace and label only after 1000 ms. Fix the three demos.

where: #bilesenler Düğmeler, #b-primary and its caption 'genişlik korunur, kare iz 1200 ms döner, yazı değişir'
problem: The live demo breaks the stated rule. I measured #b-primary at 117.1 px wide at rest and 139 px in the 'Gönderiliyor' state, so every button to its right jumps 22 px. The static 'yükleniyor' column also draws the loading button 22 px wider than 'varsayılan'. A developer copying the demo ships layout shift. Screens: out\review1\p3\N-busy.png, out\review1\tiles\1440-bilesenler-t00.png.

where: 390 px sticky bar aside.side > nav.side-nav, the link with aria-current
problem: The nav auto-scroll uses page coordinates. It puts the active label at x=38, but the nav's visible area starts at x=73, behind the brand mark. So 35 px of every active label is clipped: 'Panel ekranı' shows as 'ekranı' and 'Hareket' as 'ket'. 'Özet' and 'Renk' disappear completely. At phone width the reader cannot see which section they are in. Screens: out\review1\p6\390-view-panel.png, out\review1\p6\390-view-hareket.png.
fix: Scroll the nav itself: nav.scrollTo({left: link.offsetLeft - nav.offsetLeft - 16}). Or use scroll-padding-inline-start: 16px with scrollIntoView({inline:'start', block:'nearest'}).

where: 1440 sidebar aside.side (position sticky, height 100vh, overflow visible, content 949 px)
problem: The sidebar cannot scroll. At 1440x768, items '20 Açık noktalar', '21 Kaynaklar' and the Plan and Teknik links fall below the fold and can never be reached. At 1440x900 the Plan and Teknik links are cut. Screen: out\review1\p12\side-768.png.
fix: Set aside.side { max-height: 100vh; overflow-y: auto }. Also reduce item height from 36 to 28 px so 21 items and 2 links fit in 768 px.

where: #hareket .curve cards (Eğriler and Yaylar); #dogru captions 'Doğru' and 'Yanlış'
problem: Cards in the same row do not share baselines. Curve titles sit at 512, 512 and 517 px; spring titles at 524, 519, 529 and 524 (the grid rows stretch with the text below). The do/don't captions sit at 527, 501 and 535, and the 'Birincil eylem' card has 60 px of dead space. Carbon and Material align these captions. Screens: out\review1\tiles\1440-hareket-t01.png, 1440-hareket-t02.png, 1440-dogru-t00.png.

where: #etkilesim .pat-c column 'Süre, eğri, köken'
problem: The dl stretches to the row height, so 'Eğri' and 'Köken' float at uneven heights in all 20 patterns. In the press row, Giriş is at 464 px and Eğri at 488 px; Çıkış is at 540 px and Köken at 534 px. Screen: out\review1\tiles\1440-etkilesim-t00.png.

Icon names split mid-word ('qr_code_scann' then 'er', 'bluetooth_dis' then 'abled'), and at 1440 'radio_button_unchecke' then 'd'. Screens: out\review1\t390\390-etkilesim-g00.png, out\review1\t390\390-ikonlar-g00.png, out\review1\tiles\1440-ikonlar-t00.png.

where: 390 px tables: #kontrast 'Ölçülen çiftler', #renk token tables, #bilesenler 'Durum tablosu', #bicim 'Yükselti', #ikonlar 'Boy ve dolgu'

The token tables cut 'Görev' to one letter. The button table shows 2 of 6 states, Yükselti hides the React Native column, and the icon table hides 24 px. where: #katmanlar 'Yükleniyor' > 'Kare iz'; the 'yükleniyor' button state
problem: The 16 px outlined square with a 1 px track, next to a label, has the same shape, size and stroke as the 16 px unchecked checkbox. 'Gönderiliyor' therefore reads as a checkbox label. Under reduced motion the loader becomes a static pulsing square, which looks even more like one. Screens: out\review1\p3\N-busy.png, out\review1\tiles\1440-katmanlar-t02.png.

where: #katmanlar, Sorun bildir sheet (#sh-d) option rows; #ikonlar caption: 'seçenek düğmesinin işareti de bir ikondur (radio_button)'; #bicim '23 bileşen · hepsi 0'
problem: The three options in the Sorun bildir sheet use Material radio_button_unchecked and radio_button_checked circles (rendered at out/review1/lang/sheet-open.png). The app draws this control, not the OS. O4 allows radius above 2 px only where the OS draws its own UI. The per-component radius list has no radio entry, #ozet still says '0 px, bütün bileşenlerde', and the İkonlar caption calls the round control an icon to get around the rule.
fix: Add 'radio 0 px' to the radius list and draw it square: a 16 px box with a 1 px border.strong (border.strongOnTint on neutral.4 or neutral.5), selected state an 8 px accent.11 inner square at 110 ms hizli. Or reuse the list-row selection already in Seçim (neutral.5 ground, 2 px mark, check icon). Remove radio_button_* from the 48-icon list and delete the 'işareti de bir ikondur' sentence.

where: #renk, Nötr ölçek table, neutral.12 Görev cell: 'Birincil metin; ters yüzey (bildirim, çevrimdışı şeridi); Elle eklendi'
problem: Everywhere else the offline band is light neutral.3 (the #gece-mavisi never list, #katmanlar, the #etkilesim banner row, and the CSS comment 'never the dark inverse band'). Toasts are bg.surface (.toast and .ptoast use var(--bg-surface); the never list says 'bildirimler beyaz yüzey'). A developer working from the colour table would paint a near-black band across the top of phone screens and near-black toasts, the opposite of 'ana tonlar gri ve kırık beyaz'. That also leaves bg.inverse and its dependent roles with no named user.
fix: Set the neutral.12 Görev cell to: 'Birincil metin, güçlü ikon, Elle eklendi mürekkebi, kamera zemini, örtü'. Then either name the real users of bg.inverse, text.onInverse, text.onInverseSecondary, border.inverse and focus.ringInverse, or drop them from Anlam rolleri and from the 75-pair table.

where: #ust: 'her renk, ölçü ve süre tokens.json dosyasından gelir'; #kontrast: '75 çift · tcheck.js PASS'; #etkilesim: 'tokens.json içindeki patterns dizisinden gelir'; footer
problem: tokens.json, tcheck.js, coverage.js, shot.js, color.js and spring.js all live in the session scratchpad. The document never says where they go in the repository, or that they will be added. A developer reading tasarim.html in the repo cannot find the source of truth or rerun the checks the page cites as proof.

where: #etkilesim accordion row, Çıkış: 'içerik solar, alan kapanır' (uzun 240 ms); #kutuphaneler 'Yükseklik açma kapama', Risk: 'hedeflerde anında kapanır'
problem: The interaction table promises an animated close, but the library table says the native details element closes instantly in every target browser. The owner asked for open and close animation on everything (O5). One of the two is wrong and the developer cannot tell which.
fix: Pick one. To keep O5, close through a small helper: animate content opacity and grid-template-rows from 1fr to 0fr, remove [open] on transitionend, and close instantly under reduced motion; say so in the row. Otherwise change the accordion row to 'Çıkış: anında' and add this to the deviations in Açık nokta 03.

where: #bilesenler, Düğmeler caption: 'Birincil düğmeye basınca 1,8 sn yükleniyor durumu gösterilir'
problem: The page script sets aria-busy and swaps the label the moment the button is clicked, yet #katmanlar 'Yükleniyor' and the #etkilesim loading row say '1 sn altında gösterge yok'. Developers copy demos, and this one teaches the opposite of the rule. '1,8 sn' also reads like a product value.
fix: In the demo, delay the busy state by 1000 ms so it shows only while the fake job is still running. Change the caption to 'İş 1 saniyeyi geçerse düğme yükleniyor durumuna geçer; örnek iş 1,8 sn sürer.'

where: #katmanlar menu #m1: 'Makbuzu okut', 'Excel olarak indir Ctrl E', 'Kaydı sil'; #bilesenler Tehlike row 'Kaydı sil'
problem: In plan.html the receipt QR is scanned by the instructor's phone ('Hoca okutunca telefonu...'), not in the web panel. Records are corrected with reason codes and kept for audit (teknik.html: düzeltmeler 'silinmez'), and there is no delete-record action. Ctrl+E is the browser's search shortcut in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. The demo invents three product features that a reader will take as decided.
fix: Use plan actions only: 'Düzeltme ekle', 'Sorun bildirimini aç', 'Excel olarak indir'. For the destructive example use 'Yoklamayı erken kapat'. Drop the shortcut, or pick one that browsers do not reserve and record it under Erişilebilirlik.

where: #bilesenler Seçim, Anahtar: 'Bildirimler · Gönderilmemiş kayda günde bir hatırlatma.'
problem: This shows an in-app switch that turns reminders off. plan.html has no such setting (the daily reminder is a decision), and the doc itself says 'uygulamaya ayrı titreşim ayarı konmaz, telefonun ayarı izlenir' and 'Uygulamada ayrı hareket ayarı yok'. Demo labels read as product decisions.
fix: Replace it with a toggle the plan already backs (Devamdan muaf is already shown) or a filter switch such as 'Yalnız İncelemede göster', and keep demo labels to plan features.

where: #katmanlar dialog #dlg-d title: 'Yoklamayı erken kapat?'
problem: An imperative with a question mark is an English pattern ('Close attendance early?'). Turkish asks with mı/mi, and this is product copy that will ship.
fix: 'Yoklama erken kapatılsın mı?' (the buttons 'Vazgeç' and 'Yoklamayı kapat' stay).

where: #etkilesim popover row, Giriş: '500 ms bekleme sonra açılır'; Çıkış: 'anında solar'
problem: 'bekleme sonra' is ungrammatical, and 'anında solar' contradicts the same row's 'çıkış mikro 100 ms'.
fix: Giriş: '500 ms bekledikten sonra açılır'. Çıkış: '100 ms'de solar'.

where: #hareket intro: 'Üretken hareket'; #ekranlar Akış: 'Kamera yerel yığın geçişiyle'; #kutuphaneler: 'Erişilebilir başsız bileşenler'; #ikonlar: 'Ağırlık 400, derece 0.'
problem: English terms translated word by word read as machine-made and mislead. 'üretken' and 'ifadeci' render Carbon's productive and expressive; 'yerel yığın geçişi' is native stack transition; 'başsız' is headless; 'ilerleyici iyileştirme' is progressive enhancement; 'derece 0' turns the GRAD axis into 'degree'. #erisilebilirlik also writes 'tek Metin bileşeninde ve tek Dokunulabilir bileşeninde' for React Native's Text and Pressable, names a developer searches for verbatim.
fix: Give the Carbon terms a gloss once: 'Carbon'un iş eğrileri (productive)' and 'vurgu eğrisi (expressive)'. Then use 'sistemin ekran geçişi', 'görünüşü olmayan bileşen kütüphanesi (headless)', 'kademeli iyileştirme' ('aşamalı' would collide with the plan's Aşama), 'GRAD 0', and 'Text ve Pressable bileşenleri'.

where: #durumlar 'Durum metinleri', Bağlantı bekleniyor: 'Bu kodu hocanın telefonundaki uygulamayla okut.'; #bilesenler: 'E-postana gelen 6 haneli kod'
problem: The projector text addresses the instructor as 'sen' while naming him in the third person ('hocanın telefonundaki'), so it reads as if aimed at students in the room. Instructor-facing copy (this line, the e-mail code label, the panel toast 'AKSİS'ten indirdiğin Excel dosyasını seç') uses 'sen', while #acik 10 recommends 'siz' for instructors. The mocks neither follow the proposal nor say they are waiting for it.
